text:
sam: Heads-up — planning a hotflip of quant-kernel v4 -> v5 from staging to prod in the early morning window (02:30 UTC). Staggered pins across regions 15m apart. Deploybot will do a phased rollout. Please ack if you can monitor.
olivia: Ack, I'll be on call during the 02:00-04:00 window. I'll watch p95/p99 and GPU OOMs.
raj: Are we rolling GPU driver as well or just runtime kernel+quant bundle? If driver also, we should do extra bake.
sam: runtime kernel + quant bundle only (no driver). Build artifacts: qkv-matmul-v5 + quant-profile-2026-03-20. No kernel ABI change.
jen: Release notes drafted in PR#4520. Short summary: improved matmul throughput for long sequences, possible regressions on tiny batch sizes.
deploy-bot: scheduled roll: /rollout start --bundle=quant-kernel-v5 --stagger=15m --regions=us-east-1,eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --pin-ttl=60m
olivia: Smoke plan? What signals to watch?
sam: Smoke: 30min canary per region at 5% traffic. Watch: latency p95 > +30% vs baseline (10m avg), error rate > 0.5%, OOMs or evictions > 0.1%.
raj: Add KV cache miss increase > 15% as a signal (we saw behavior in staging before).
jen: Also add token-gen time p95 and batch reject rate.
alan: I'll have a rollback checklist ready. Trigger rules: any of those signals sustained for 3 consecutive 5m buckets or one critical OOM -> rollback.
sam: Can we set auto-pin on failure to revert to quant-kernel-v4? deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: auto-fallback configured: on-failure -> pin-to=quant-kernel-v4, cooldown=30m
olivia: Who is primary on-call for metric escalations? @alan primary, @olivia secondary.
alan: I'll open a monitoring pane and share links in #eng-runtime before the flip.
jen: Docs update: add note about quant-serialization changes. I'll push a tiny blurb to the release notes after smoke.
sam: small CLI snippet for operators:
```
# start phased rollout
deploy-bot start --artifact quant-kernel-v5 --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1 --slice 5% --stagger 15m --canary-duration 30m --pin-ttl 60m
```
raj: Confirming we will not change canary sizes mid-flight unless we see stable metrics.
olivia: I'll post hourly status in this thread during the window.
sam: Thanks all. If anything spikes, ping @oncall-eng and I'll hit the emergency pin.
alan: copying smoke dashboard: https://dash.redwood/s/quant-kernel-v5-smoke
olivia: acked, see you at 02:00 UTC :coffee: 
deploy-bot: rollout started (timestamp 1717656000) — canary us-east-1 at 5%.
sam: update 02:50 UTC — us-east canary stable, no regressions, promoting eu-west at 5% now.
olivia: eu-west looks ok first 15m, p95 +12% but within threshold.
raj: ap-southeast canary scheduled in 03:20 UTC, I'll be watching.
jen: small alert: batch reject rate jumped to 1.2% in eu-west at 02:58 UTC, but it recovered within 2 buckets. Keeping watch.
alan: batch rejects still slightly elevated, but no OOMs. Holding steady.
sam: decision: continue staged rollout but reduce slice to 3% for the remaining regions and extend canary to 45m.
deploy-bot: updated rollout: slice=3% --canary-duration=45m --stagger=15m
olivia: noted. I'll escalate if p95 goes above +25%.
raj: if batch reject >2% again we should rollback.
jen: I'll add a blurb to release notes about the reduced slice.
sam: great work team. Final note: after full rollout, we'll run a 6h post-deploy smoke and check cost/unit token for regressions.
deploy-bot: rollout complete in all regions (timestamp 1717659000). No auto-fallbacks triggered.
